configurations.name: pages-dev-public
runtimeArgs: VITE_SUPABASE_URL= VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= npx vite build --outDir dist.local && npx wrangler pages dev dist.local --port 8789 -b SUPABASE_URL= -b SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= --kv AI_USAGE

configurations.name: pages-dev-lan
runtimeArgs: VITE_SUPABASE_URL= VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= npx vite build --outDir dist.local && npx wrangler pages dev dist.local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8789 -b SUPABASE_URL= -b SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= --kv AI_USAGE
